engine.notes: Dad's Garage and Whole World, both over 30 years old, anchor the city; Onward, Dynamic El Dorado and The Alley Stage are the newer rooms, and the suburbs are served by schools in Roswell and Dunwoody. Decatur has no improv venue of its own (Whole World's first show was at Eddie's Attic in 1994). The jam scene lives on Instagram: The Sandbox ATL studio in East Atlanta Village hosts a Sunday musical

entries.name: Dad's Garage Theatre
entries.area: Old Fourth Ward (569 Ezzard St SE)
entries.summary: Atlanta's flagship improv theatre since 1995, a 501(c)(3) with its own Old Fourth Ward theatre and the React black box, producing improvised and scripted comedy for over 30,000 people a year and training all ages through DGU.
entries.schedule: Fri & Sat shows at 8pm and 10pm; free community improv jam most Tuesdays, signups 7pm, jam 8pm
signals: Founded June 1995; in its own Ezzard Street theatre since 2015
Over 30,000 attendees a year
DGU six-week classes in improv, stand-up and sketch, plus 55+ classes
Audition-only Conservatory and diversity scholarships
Free Tuesday community jam open to all
October 2026 runs: Scandal! The Bare, Felt Street, The Bottle Tree
entries.reasons: Three decades, its own theatre plus a second black box, hundreds of shows a year, a free weekly jam and a school with a conservatory; class dates and prices sit on an external registration site.

entries.name: Whole World Improv Theatre
entries.summary: Atlanta's longest-running improv theatre, a nonprofit founded in 1994 with its own Midtown stage, weekly short-form shows and a ten-week class ladder from Beginner to Advanced plus master classes and youth programmes.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu-Sat around 8pm, incl. Thursday Happy Hour and The Classic Improv Show; Saturdays 10pm in October
signals: Founded September 1994; Spring Street theatre since 1995
Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced programs: ten weeks, $295, each ending in a show
Fall 2026 Beginner started Sep 14; one-day workshop Oct 17
Master classes in character work and musical improv
16-week youth and teen program; voted best theatre for kids by Nickelodeon Parents' Pick
Neurodiverse X-Group for ages 11-17
entries.reasons: Thirty-two years in its own Midtown theatre, the most complete dated class ladder in the city and weekly shows; it is a short-form house with less national profile than Dad's.

entries.name: Onward Theatre
entries.summary: A 501(c)(3) comedy theatre in Adair Park built around underrepresented voices, with improvised house formats on Friday and Saturday nights and classes from Improv Basics and Comedy 101 to musical improv and stand-up.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri & Sat 8pm (The Coven, Eulogy, Monster of the Week, Direct Depozit); Dinner Party Oct 3, 2026
signals: Nonprofit focused on diverse comedy voices
Improv Basics, Comedy 101, Musical Improv, Stand-Up Masterclass 101 and 201
House improv formats every Friday and Saturday
Monthly all-women stand-up showcase, Ladies Night
Events listed Sep 25 - Oct 3, 2026
entries.reasons: A real venue with weekend improv formats and a growing class list, but it is new and the class pages carry no dates or prices.

entries.name: Dynamic El Dorado
entries.area: Old Fourth Ward (572 Edgewood Ave NE)
entries.summary: Don Miguel Figueroa's comedy incubator in the Old Fourth Ward, running live improv, stand-up and sketch every week with weekly open mics and improv jams, plus classes in improv, clown, stand-up and sketch.
entries.schedule: Weekend shows, weekly open mics and improv jams incl. a Late Night Open Improv Jam; show listed Sep 25, 2026
signals: Founded 2020 in the Old Fourth Ward
Live comedy every week, per the site
Weekly open mics and improv jams with online signup
Classes in improv, clown, stand-up and sketch
Hosted a bilingual improv jam with Teatro Ilegal
Founder Don Miguel Figueroa
entries.reasons: A six-year-old venue with shows and jams most nights and a broad class menu, but its Square-built site shows listings only through its store, so dates and levels are hard to read.

entries.name: The Alley Stage
entries.summary: Cobb County's comedy venue on Marietta Square, with stand-up on weekends, an improv night every Wednesday including the audience-game show Y'all's Line Is It Anyway? and DrunkProv, and six-week Level 1 and 2 improv classes.
entries.schedule: Improv @ The Alley Wednesdays 8pm (Y'all's Line 1st Wed, DrunkProv 2nd Wed); stand-up Fri & Sat 8pm; open mic Tue 7pm
signals: Level 1 improv: Tuesdays Oct 27 - Dec 1, 2026 with Andrew Chance
Level 2 improv: Mondays Oct 26 - Nov 30, 2026 with Rachel LaForce
Both levels end in a student showcase
Weekly Wednesday improv night
Payment plans for classes
Shows scheduled through Dec 26, 2026
entries.reasons: A permanent room with weekly improv and dated two-level classes that end in showcases, but it is young, stand-up-first and offers no path beyond Level 2.

entries.name: Atlanta Workshop Players
entries.summary: A nonprofit performing-arts school founded in 1981, teaching weekly adult classes in improv, acting and on-camera work at its Studio 13 black box in Roswell, where its Improv Maniacs troupe stages ticketed improv shows.
entries.schedule: Improv Maniacs shows Sep 26 and Nov 21, 2026 at Studio 13, 7:30pm
signals: Adult weekly classes in theatre, improv, on-camera and musical theatre
Improv Maniacs house troupe
Own black box, Studio 13, in Roswell
Classes for kids, teens and adults, 2026-27 season
entries.reasons: Forty-five years and its own studio, but improv is one strand of an acting school and shows are occasional rather than weekly.

entries.name: Alliance Theatre
entries.summary: Atlanta's major regional theatre offers improv inside its education programme: free two-hour improv workshops, an adult Improv I class, and youth improv camps in Decatur and Marietta.
entries.schedule: Free improv workshops Tue Oct 6 (sold out) and Dec 15, 2026, 6:30-8:30pm
signals: Free improv workshops with a 20% class discount
Adult Improv I single-session class
Youth improv camps for rising grades 5-6 in Decatur and Marietta
Based at the Woodruff Arts Center, 1280 Peachtree St NE
entries.reasons: Unmatched standing and a free entry point, but improv is a sliver of a large acting programme with no ladder and no improv shows.

entries.name: Stage Door Theatre
entries.summary: Dunwoody's community theatre runs Sunday adult improv classes at the Dunwoody Cultural Arts Center, taught by Dad's Garage performer Avery Sharpe-Steele, from a beginner Level 1.5 to an advanced Level 4.
entries.schedule: Sundays Sep 13 - Nov 8, 2026: Level 1.5 at 4pm, Level 4 at 7pm; $275
signals: Two adult levels, 1.5 and 4
Eight Sundays, $275
Instructor performs with Dad's Garage
Spring term ran Mar 30 - Jun 1
Held at 5339 Chamblee Dunwoody Rd
entries.reasons: Dated, affordable adult classes with a credentialed teacher in a stable civic venue, but no improv shows and a two-level programme.
